name: eslint
_note: Pinned with the same committed npm-pack discipline as the other npm-compat packages. ESLint is a multi-file CommonJS package rather than a self-contained dist bundle. setup-eslint.mjs verifies the complete installed eslint package payload against this tarball byte-for-byte, then compiles the verified installed path so Node/pnpm can resolve ESLint's pinned dependency graph from the package's real importer context.
